name: Kelly
quote: A school track star
ability_description: Sprint for 4s to activate. When activated, first 1 shot on target inflicts 106% damage. Lasts for 5s.
biography: In childhood, she was a happy go-lucky kid with her adopted-mom, Rena, and step-dad, Andrew. When her mom and Andrew got divorced she was extremely sad but kept in contact with Andrew. Kelly was always a good runner, but in highschool the track coach discovered her and she became the school track star. When she finds herself on an unknown island, she will be forced to make tough choices that will decide her future path.
awaken_ability_description: Sprint for 4s to activate. When activated, first 1 shot on target inflicts 106% damage. Lasts for 5s.

name: Andrew
quote: Andrew‘s first wife had a daughter Kelly
ability_description: Armor damage reduction boosted by 4%, Additional 1% damage reduction for each teammate within 15m.
biography: Andrew’s first wife had a daughter Kelly, who was a close to him as a biological daughter. When he got divorced, he still tried to be involved in Kelly"s life. Andrew was a sergeant in the LLPD before his new fiancé died in a brutal gang attack. He lost his job trying to find out her killers while also fighting back against Horizon who was trying to take over the police department.
awaken_ability_description: Armor damage reduction boosted by 4%, Additional 1% damage reduction for each teammate within 15m.

name: Hayato Yagami
quote: Hayato had a lot riding on his shoulders as the eldest heir to the Yagami corporation
ability_description: Reduce frontal damage by 2% for every 10% of max. HP loss.
biography: Hayato had a lot riding on his shoulders as the eldest heir to the Yagami corporation. He was raised into a life where his existence was meant to serve the honor and glory of his family. When their family corporation was acquired by Horizon, he didn"t hesitate to get involved in corporate affairs to make sure the Yagamis would still operate with honor.
awaken_ability_description: Reduce frontal damage by 2% for every 10% of max. HP loss.

name: Miguel
quote: Miguel is an Elite Soldier in the Special Forces.
ability_description: Miguel Can Gain EP for each kill.
biography: Dedicating his life to law and justice, Miguel has led his squad through countless crime-fighting operations with a 100% success rate. His team"s known for tackling impossible jobs, which is why nobody expected the tragic incident from 6 months ago. Miguel would soon realize that, the hurt and anger following a failed mission is nothing compared to that of a friend"s betrayal.

name: Laura
quote: Laura is a disciplined and outstanding special agent.
ability_description: Accuracy increased while scoped in.
biography: Laura was top of her class and the most outstanding sharpshooter her platoon ever produced. It was only when her father disappeared in the war that she chose her path to become a special agent to try and find him. Still on her search, she works for an agency eliminating the bad guys plaguing her city. Laura now has to rethink her life when her new target, Rafael, isn’t who they tell her he is.

name: A124
quote: A124 is a humanoid robot.
ability_description: Unleashes an electromagnetic wave that disables enemies; skill activation and interrupts their interaction countdown.
biography: Born to serve a purpose, A124 was programmed to be a killing machine. She was certainly not built for human interactions and complicated emotions, but who could stop a young mind from trying? With those battle skills and a curious mind, the world is literally her oyster.

name: Wukong
quote: The Monkey King is Here!
ability_description: Transforms into a bush with 10% reduction in movement speed, lasting for 10s. Cooldown: 75s. Transformation ends when Wukong attacks. CD resets when Wukong takes down an enemy within 10s after skill release.
biography: Once a member of Task Force Mecha, the special unit of Horizon, Wukong was known for his cyborg build and holographic prowess on the battlefield. Yet, beneath the metal and circuitry lay a cruel truth long forgotten—a truth recalled when Wukong was betrayed by a trusted ally: he was merely a subject of Horizon's ruthless experiments, implanted with a mind-control chip that disrupted his consciousness and obscured the pain of his past. Fortunately, Wukong got rid of the chip and was freed from Horizon's grip. Determined to expose the dark secrets behind the experiments, Wukong has embarked on a perilous journey of redemption and justice.

name: Kla
quote: Kla is a cage fighter who seeks revenge for his parents.
ability_description: Increased fist damage.
biography: Kla overcame many obstacles in his youth, but the assassination of his parents was too much for him – setting him down a path of anger and violence. He lost himself in the anger and guilt revolving around their deaths and found himself in a deep hole. It was only after finally facing one of the men responsible for his parents’ death did he find clarity and his path in life.

name: Misha
quote: Misha is a racecar driver looking for her missing brother.
ability_description: Increase driving speed and reduce damage taken while inside vehicles. Harder to be targeted at while driving.
biography: After her parents were killed, she gave up on school and Misha became a racecar driver to pay the bills and support herself and her brother, Maxim. One day Maxim, went missing and she dropped everything to find him. Her search crossed paths with Andrew"s as they looked for their respective families. Their journey will take her down new and dangerous paths with the end far out of sight.

name: Moco
quote: Moco is tech genius that joined Horizon
ability_description: Marks the enemy hit, exposes their location in the field of view, the minimap, and shares it with teammates for 3s. The enemy, if moving while marked, will have their location exposed for a longer time, up to 4s.
biography: Moco is tech genius that joined Horizon, the most prestigious tech company on the continent. But when she finds out they are up to nefarious acts, she pulls a disappearing act, wipes her identity from the public record and goes into hiding to find a way to stop their plans. She likes to operate alone, but will soon realize this threat is too big for her to take on by herself.
awaken_ability_description: Markings on hit enemies last longer when enemies move(up to 6.5s longer).

name: Caroline
quote: Caroline is a rich girl with substantial family connections.
ability_description: When holding a shotgun, movement speed is increased.
biography: Caroline possessed the adroitness, politeness, and sophistication that most wealthy girls lacked. She worked within social standards but adeptly manipulated people to her liking. She is still a student, but due to her family connections, she is sometimes pulled into Horizon plans. She and Hayato are acquaintances and sometimes help each other out.

name: Paloma
quote: Paloma is a passionate but ruthless woman who knows how to lead.
ability_description: Accuracy increases after destroying a Gloo Wall.
biography: Everyone who comes to know Paloma, looks up to her in one way or another. A wildflower blossoming in an impoverished slum. This sometimes comes from her unshakable self-confidence that causes people to gravitate towards her as she projects a sense of future safety and vision. The only thing that can distract her from her own vision of the future, is the love of her life, Antonio.

name: Ford
quote: Sea Captain
ability_description: Reduce damage taken outside safe zone.
biography: Ford was once a captain on the open sea. He has now committed himself to building a safe haven for refugees. He is everyone’s “wise and reliable uncle”, who knows the waterways into and out of Bermuda. Knowing too well how betrayals hurt, Ford strives for a balance between trust and caution. He thought his will indestructible, that was until he met Olivia...

name: Rafael
quote: Rafael is a hired gun who has seen severe tragedy in his life.
ability_description: Silencing effect when using snipers and marksman rifles. Enemies hit and downed suffer faster HP loss.
biography: Rafael was a sweet family man until a terrible family tragedy sent him down the path of cold-heartedness and revenge. He now searches the world not only for the man who destroyed his family while taking contracts to bring justice to other evils. As the years went by, he realized life wasn’t as black and white as it seemed. The appearance of the lovely Laura in his life has now thrown another wrench into the carefully crafted structure of his life.

name: Maxim
quote: Maxim is searching for love in a harsh unpredictable world.
ability_description: Reduce time for eating mushrooms and using med kits.
biography: Maxim felt guilty that his sister, Misha, left school to take care of him. But he didn"t have many practical skills and turned to food-eating v-tubing as his part-time job. One day, he and his schoolmate Kelly were abducted from a school bus and sent to the island of Bermuda. The island would change him - he"d become healthier, stronger, more confident and better prepared to face a harsh world.

name: Nikita
quote: Nikita is a professional bodyguard.
ability_description: Reload speed increases by 20%. Every time the skill user hits an enemy, said target will get a 50% healing deduction that lasts for 6s (max. deduction: 50%).
biography: Her utmost important mission is to protect Caroline, the daughter of Horizon"s Vice President. Graduating as a top marksman from military school, Nikita could most certainly have greater ambitions than escorting a teenage girl, but it appears that she"s happy with the way things are. One has to wonder if she has her own objectives, ones that may not have Horizon"s best interest in mind.

name: Antonio
quote: Antonio is a notorious gangster, forced into a life of violence.
ability_description: Get 20 extra Shield Points at the start of the match. Recovers Shield Points after surviving combat.
biography: Antonio is the kind of guy that people try to avoid eye contact with. It seems like he would punch you in the face if you met his gaze for too long. In actuality, underneath that gangster-look, he is shy and sensitive. Growing up in local gang wars, he was never violent for no reason – he only protected himself and his loved ones – his wife, his family, and his Chihuahua named Poncho.

name: Olivia
quote: Olivia is a warm-hearted soul with the ability to heal and revive.
ability_description: Increase healing effects by 30% and spread 90% of the user's single-target healing amount to teammates within 20m
biography: After an operation from a childhood accident, Olivia developed a special ability to heal and revive - with one miraculous touch, she can gently will the pain away and promote healing in injuries. Despite her traumatic childhood, Olivia grew to become one of the most caring and compassionate among her peers. However, she has little social interaction outside Ford’s safe zone and shies away from the world.

name: Alvaro
quote: Alvaro is an explosive young man trying to find his past.
ability_description: 1s before detonating, grenade produces 3 extra grenades, which can cause 20% damage of their original.
biography: Alvaro is a young man with an explosive personality. A childhood accident gifted him with special explosive powers, at the cost of his memories. He is lost in a constant circle of searching for his memories and needing to use his powers to save those he cares for. The only constant he has found in his life is Kapella, his childhood best friend, whom he no longer consciously remembers.
awaken_ability_description: 1s before detonating, grenade produces 3 extra grenades, which can cause 20% damage of their original.

name: Alok
quote: Alok is a world famous DJ, ready to drop a beat.
ability_description: While the aura is acrive, music notes that last for 5s will be dropped 2m behind the skill user every 2s. Teammates who pick up the music mpte will receive the same effect as the aura.
biography: "Using the power of music, Alok left Brazil and travelled the world. His name means “light”. He has signed a contract and a closed concert will happen on Free Fire’s battleground island for some VIP guests!"
awaken_ability_description: While the aura is acrive, music notes that last for 5s will be dropped 2m behind the skill user every 2s. Teammates who pick up the music mpte will receive the same effect as the aura.

name: Notora
quote: Notora is a motorcycle racer.
ability_description: When driving a vehicle, restore HP of all members on the vehicle. Effects do not stack.
biography: The daughter of a biker gang family, Notora never had much of a say regarding her lifestyle. Despite her strength and toughness, she has a hidden distaste for pointless violence deep down. Her entire team was wiped out during a vicious gang rivalry. Fortunately, death turned a blind eye to her once again. Notora would soon realize though, as she was captured alive and exiled to Bermuda islands, that it was not luck that brought her there.

name: Shani
quote: Shani is an engineer who works at a junkyard.
ability_description: When using an active skill, gives 30 Shield Points to self and teammates within 10m. The Shield Points decay after 5s, after which players can obtain the effects again. Cooldown: 10s.
biography: Shani is a self-made engineer. Her parents were killed in a building explosion when she was 18 and she lost everything she had. She wandered around for a few years doing odd jobs to make a living, when a junkyard owner took her in and gave her a place to call home. There she was able to work with junk parts and engineer to her hearts" content.

name: Joseph
quote: Joseph is a rich, power tech magnate set on changing the world.
ability_description: Become immune from disruptive effects (e.g. slowdown, marking, skill-silencing) and have a movement speed boost.
biography: The crowned king ladies’ man of New Dawn, Joseph, founded Nerve Labs, a successful tech company. At the end of the Great Collapse, Joseph got wind of Horizon’s nefarious plans for humanity and made an enemy out of the extraordinarily intelligent scientist.

name: Steffie
quote: Steffie is a spark plug graffiti artist who pushes boundaries.
ability_description: Creates an area that blocks throwables. Allies in the area will restore armor durability every second and ammo damage taken from enemies will reduce.
biography: Steffie has had a long feud with establishments, starting with her parents. She rebelled early on in her life and has kept continuing to do so. Her life hit a hard turn when she slighted the tech giant, Horizon, and was forced to go on the run or become fodder for their experiments. She was saved by Moco and soon after found the Mambas, a rebel force that seems to be her true calling.

name: Kapella
quote: Kapella is a pop star but also has a secret identity.
ability_description: Heal teammates with ammo and heal more with a Heal Pistol.
biography: Kapella was orphaned as a child and adopted by the tech magnate, Joseph. The energetic young woman was extremely observant and intuitive. She became a world famous singer and a Mambas" member. Her personality surely plays a key role in her success, but of course, a star isn"t born alone. When Alvaro, a memory of her past, reappears, she must decide what is most important in her life.

name: Jota
quote: Jota is a parkour expert and stuntman.
ability_description: When using guns, hitting an enemy recovers some HP for the user.
biography: Jota grew up in a middle class family, was an average student and had a family who loved him. Overall, a pretty normal life - but he felt trapped and needed more action in his life. He lived in a city with skyscrapers that filled the skyline and felt trapped, so he started climbing to find places to see the sky.

name: Clu
quote: Clu is a modern day private detective.
ability_description: Locate positions of enemies who are not in prone or squat position.
biography: Clu grew up in a suburb of a large city. Her parents were wealthy, never had to worry about the basics of life and she had a very loving childhood. When she was a teenager, her dad was recruited for the war effort. The war ended a year later and he never came home. He was never found. Clu became a private eye detective after graduating high school in hopes she could uncover details on her dad"s disappearance

name: Wolfrahh
quote: Wolfrahh grew up hiding from the world after a traumatic event.
ability_description: Every elimination will add one spectator, and the number of spectators will not reduce. With each additional spectator, damage taken from headshots reduces by 4% (max 12%) and damage to enemies by headshots increases by 10% (max 30%)
biography: Wolfrahh grew up hiding from the world after a traumatic event. After facing his fears, he was able to overcome some of his confidence issues but still had trouble finding his identity. He was invited to the largest, underground VR game competition on the continent to showcase his skills. However, in the process he discovered secrets - his choices surrounding those will define his life.

name: Luqueta
quote: Luqueta was an exchange student from overseas.
ability_description: Every elimination increases max. Shield Points permanently by 15. Max. boost: 45. Clears the effects once the player is eliminated or the round is reset.
biography: Luqueta was an exchange student from overseas. He moved because of his dad"s job.His dad wanted him to follow in his footsteps and get an MBA and get into business. But Luqueta saw his dad"s life and didn"t want any of that. He was always an atheletic kid. When he moved he started playing soccer for the school, he knew he was good when he was a kid but in high school he became a star. He didn"t even have to try that hard and was amazing.

name: K
quote: K is a professor and jiujitsu expert.
ability_description: Max EP increases. Jiujitsu Mode: Allies within certain range get an increase in EP conversion rate. Psychology Mode: Recover EP.
biography: K was a smart kid, but like most kids his age he didn’t take school seriously. When he was 16, still a junior in high school, he got into a car crash and injured his spine. His doctors told him he would never walk again. But he refused to give up - this would not be the end for him. He went to physical therapy, did his own therapy at home, and found a trainer to help him push further. In a year he was walking; in two he was playing sports. This experience taught him a few things that would stick with him for life. - Don’t take life for granted. - He had to delve into himself to get through the experience and he learned to understand himself, his motivations as well as his place in the world. - A side effect of this was that he could now read and understand the people around him in the same ways. - He also wanted to make his body and mind stronger to never be injured the same way again

name: Dasha
quote: Dasha is a prankster and rebel set on choosing her own fate.
ability_description: Reduce damage taken and recovery time from falls. Reduce rate of recoil buildup and maximum recoil.
biography: Dasha is a party-girl who abides by the saying "work hard, play harder". She"s a little mischievous, often starting trouble when she doesn"t intend to. She"s gone through a lot in her life, but she"s happy to have found the Mambas who appreciate her diverse array of skills. But now she"s gotten her involved in something she didn"t intend, but only time will tell if it is worth the squeeze.

name: Chrono
quote: Chrono is a bounty hunter from another universe.
ability_description: Creates an impenetrable force field that block 1000 DMG. Unable to attack outside enemies from within the field. All effects last for 10s. Cooldown: 45s.
biography: Chrono comes from a parallel universe where there is a higher science and technology level than the levels in our current world Earth. He had a normal childhood in his original universe. His parents were famous lawyers who fought against poverty and helped bring the poor homeless people up into society. Because of this he always had an awareness about disadvantaged groups since he was very young and as he grew older he found ways to do his part to help as well.

name: Shirou
quote: Shirou is a teenager with a strong sense of responsibility
ability_description: When user is hit, the attacker is marked (only visible to user). First shot on marked enemies has additional armor penetration.
biography: Shirou is a teenager with a strong sense of responsibility who has risked everything to protect his family and hometown. He works as a delivery boy delivering packages around the busy and congested city of Griza. He will have to overcome big odds and go up against forces that are larger than him to find his truth and true calling in life.

name: Xayne
quote: Extreme Athlete
ability_description: Enters the Xtreme state and instantly obtains 70 temporary Shield Points for 15s, during which each knockdown of an enemy restores the temporary Shield Points gained through this skill back to 70 and resets the state duration. Once the state ends, the Shield Points earned from this process will be removed. Cooldown: 75s.
biography: Xayne was always interested in more extreme activities even when she was a kid. She prefers the adrenaline rush of xtreme sports instead of human interaction. Free-spirit, she wants to explore life and find its limits. If someone questions her ability to accomplish a mission, she will definitely find a way to do it.

name: Maro
quote: Falconer
ability_description: Damage increases with distance, up to 20%. Damage to marked enemies increases by 5%. Maro's Banner
biography: Maro prefers the company of animals over humans. He feels humans often overthink everything and forget about the true meaning of life. He wants to be a free spirit and hopes that he can also help bring other humans closer to nature through his birds.

name: Skyler
quote: Entertainment CEO
ability_description: Unleash a sonic wave forward that damages Gloo Walls. Also, each Gloo Wall deployed will result in HP recovery. Recovery effects do not stack.
biography: Skyler got his rise to fame as the hottest pop singer-dancer in the country, and he is now the CEO of the largest entertainment company in Vietnam. Driven to be the best musical talent in the business and to also find the best talent. He doesn"t like to lose and believes that creativity allows people to see the good in the world instead of the bad.

name: D-bee
quote: D-bee has an extrovert personality
ability_description: When firing while moving, movement speed and accuracy increase.
biography: D-bee has an extrovert personality and enjoys meeting new poeple. He believes that the meaning of life is creating, and that"s the reason why he become a music maker. He is also fascinated by dancing and music.

name: Dimitri
quote: Dimitri is the sound technology engineer and musician.
ability_description: Creates a healing zone. Inside, users and allies recover HP. When downed, users and allies can self-recover to get up.
biography: Dimitri is the elder brother of Thiva. In his daily life, he would spend most of his day at the lab developing new sound technology. After he found his passion for music, he realized that helping the world and improving people"s lives moving forward through his technological creations might be one of his dreams.

name: Thiva
quote: Thiva is the lead singer and musician in a band.
ability_description: Rescues (help-up) teammates faster. User recovers HP upon a successful help up.
biography: Thiva is the little brother of Dimitri. He was innately talented and played music throughout his childhood. He really wants to help the world and improve people"s lives but believes the best way to do that is to reach the individual with a true message through his music.

name: Leon
quote: Basketballer
ability_description: Recovers HP after engagement in combat
biography: Leon is a university student that has some extreme basketball skills and isn"t afraid to show them. He can jump higher than almost any one he knows with the help of his bionic leg. He has an interest in electronic and knows how to fix and tinker with his leg when it malfunctions. He may seem like he only cares about basketball, but he uses the sport not only to support his family but also his friends.

name: Otho
quote: Memory Master
ability_description: Forms a memory mist when an enemy is eliminated, revealing positions of other enemies close by.
biography: Otho has an imaginative yet very practical mind. He is scared to death of forgetting the memories of his past and is trying to find ways to preserve the past. He is getting closer every day and in the process has developed a device that allows him to see other"s intentions. When he isn"t researching more mechanisms to memory, he is out with his friends and spending time daydreaming with his dog.

name: Kenta
quote: Bladesmith
ability_description: Unleashes a swirling tempest that moves forward quickly and lasts 8s, dealing 25 DMG to enemies hit. While the tempest is active, tap the skill again to teleport to its current location and obtain a shield for 5s with 20% DMG reduction after teleporting. Cooldown: 45s.
biography: Kenta is a skilled blacksmith and a powerful bodyguard. He has vowed to become the Yagami family's sharpest blade, clearing away all obstacles in their path.

name: Nairi
quote: Nairi is a man who chases storms looking for answers.
ability_description: Deployed Gloo Walls will automatically restore durability and provide HP-healing effects for nearby teammates.
biography: Nairi found an interest in weather at a young age when he was forced away from cold climates. But his love for snow led him to find a way to get himself back there. He developed micromanipulation climate technology to allow him to survive in the most extreme environments. Now he spends his time rock climbing, hiking and chasing storms looking for the answers to predicting climate.

name: Homer
quote: Homer is a blind assassin in constant search of his truth.
ability_description: Releases a drone to the nearest frontal enemy, creating a 5m-diameter pulse explosion which reduces enemy movement speed and firing speed and inflicts damage on them.
biography: Homer is a blind man who is not only an assassin, but also one of the founders of the thriving tech gang in Griza. However, Homer, who had faded out of power in recent years, now only wants to find the truth behind the strange disease that blinded him in his childhood, the mysterious research institute he called his school and the rare earth mineral linked to it all.

name: J.Biebs
quote: J.Biebs is a man who wants to unite a fractured world.
ability_description: Skill user and allies can block damage using EP. In this case, the amount of EP deducted from allies will be added to the skill user EP.
biography: J.Biebs is a man who wants to unite a fractured world. Through his childhood experiences, he learned that the answer to people’s problems is not money or power but the actual connection between people. He has decided to use his singing skills to dedicate his life to reunite the world.

name: Iris
quote: Iris is a deaf assassin who is chock full of energy.
ability_description: Within a certain time after releasing the skill, the skill user can attack a Gloo Wall to mark the enemies near it and penetrate the Gloo Wall to cause damage to said enemies (damage inflicted will be lower than usual).
biography: With her keen vision, Iris is good at predicting enemy's actions to seize opportunities to win. If you're worried that her rhetoric, mindless optimism, and hyper-individualism will affect your cooperation, don’t. Iris never cooperates with anyone - except for Homer who unconditionally accepts her, and cleans up all her messes.

name: A-Patroa
quote: Music Shop Boss
ability_description: The exclusive skill slot can be equipped with any owned skill and the remaining slots are automatically unlocked when you obtain this character.
biography: A-Patroa is a strong, confident woman who runs a music shop in the middle of a dangerous neighborhood. Her shop doubles as a safe haven, anyone can come to her for help. On top of that, she uses her music to help people experience their lives in new and different ways to help them.

name: Tatsuya
quote: He is willing to trust to make his city a better place.
ability_description: Rushes forward quickly for 0.3s and resets the cooldown by knocking down an enemy within 10s after skill release. Cooldown: 90s.
biography: Tatsuya is torn between his feelings of betrayal and his love for his family. He doesn’t know how to deal with this dichotomy of feelings and willingly allows himself to get pulled into trouble. It is only after he and his brother, Shirou, need to work together to solve a conspiracy that he realizes he is not alone in the world and has the power to change his environment for the better.

name: Luna
quote: Luna is the spark plug and extremely capable leader of the Guild.
ability_description: Increase firing rate by 5%. When user hits an enemy, a maximun of 10% of firing rate converts into movement speed, and skill resets when user survives the combat.
biography: Luna is the daughter of a complicated man with a complicated past. She matured early dealing with his recklessness and the recklessness of the adults she grew up around. When her father’s leadership in the Guild was challenged and was eventually kidnapped, Luna had to step up and create her own footsteps to take charge of the group and restore order to the community.

name: Santino
quote: Sometimes you need to chase your dream to be happy！
ability_description: Spawn a mannequin forward, then use this skill again to teleport to the mannequin's position.
biography: Born in poverty, Santino loved art ever since he was a child. He studied at a renowned art school where his talent in design flourished. After graduating, Santino established his fashion brand, Angelic, and became a celebrity with a keen eye for marketing. With great success in the field, he is always in the spotlight of the fasion world.

name: Sonia
quote: The future belongs to nanotechnology.
ability_description: Deploys a nanotech shield when taking fatal damage and restores the same HP amount as the shield if the user knocks down an enemy while the shield is active.
biography: Sonia is a genetically modified nanoscientist with exceptional intelligence and expertise in nanobiotechnology.

name: Suzy
quote: Every mission has a price. Are you ready to pay?
ability_description: Your enemy markings have bounty value. Anyone on the ally team who eliminates a marked enemy will earn 100 in-match currency. You will earn an extra 100 for eliminating an enemy.
biography: As a bounty hunter, Suzy is composed and decisive, and she excels at planning and executing her tasks.

name: Orion
quote: From now on, I will do what ever I want!
ability_description: Increases max. EP. Consumes EP to become immune from damage and absorbs enemy HP for a short time.
biography: Orion, a vengeful beast who specializes in wielding the Crimson Energy during combat.

name: Ignis
quote: Shut up in the face of my flames!
ability_description: Releases a flaming screen that moves forward. Enemies and Gloo Walls getting in touch will take burning damage. Skill uses can be stored.
biography: Ignis is a superpowered teenager who possesses the innate ability to Igniste objects. In his spare time, he fights crime and upholds justice, but often finds himself causing unintended trouble due to his powers. The public criticizes Ignis for his actions, and during his rebellious adolescence, he responds with a defiant attitude. However, this does not hinder him from standing up for the people and the city, at least for now.

name: Ryden
quote: A 16-year-old inventive genius
ability_description: Release an explosive spider in the target direction to decelerate an enemy within its detection range and cause them to bleed.
biography: As a 16-year-old inventive genius, Ryden's rationality and knowledge both surpass his peers. The little boy, who used to sit under the wings of his sister Suzy, is now vanquishing the battlefields. His talented inventions will pave the way for him.

name: Kairos
quote: Kindness and restraint, turbulence and desire - these are never-ending battles within me.
ability_description:
Defense Mode: Automatically recovers EP until full. 
Breaker Mode: When EP is full, inflicts extra damage to enemy Shield Points and armor durability, consuming EP until it reaches 0.
biography: A former soldier of the Special Forces. His fate took a sharp turn when encountering a mysterious energy source, which transformed his body and instilled a constant craving for more energy

name: Kassie
quote: Switch on. Now, let's play a game
ability_description: Forms a healing bond with the target teammate to slowly restore HP for self and the target. Use again to significantly heal the target.
biography: A paranoid, eccentric neuroscientist who walks the line between good and evil. She is obsessed with electroshock therapies and follows her own set of rules.

name: Lila
quote: Ready for some glooy pranks?
ability_description: Decelerates enemies and vehicles hit with rifles. Freezes the enemies knocked down while decelerated and obtains an extra Gloo Wall.
biography: A naturally happy-go-lucky person, she radiates positivity and joy.

name: Koda
quote: Let me show you around. Beware of the foxes!
ability_description: Activates the Aurora power for 8s. Increases movement speed by15% and discovers enemies behind cover within 50m every 1s (unable to detect those crouching or prone). Cooldown:45s. (While parachuting, highlights enemy locations within the field of view but the effect is not shared with teammates.)
biography: The nature-loving boy has longed for an adventure in the outside world. Inspired by friends, Koda began to explore what is beyond the familiar.

name: Jai
quote: Jai was a man who believed in justice.
ability_description: After taking down an opponent, the gun's magazine automatically gets reloaded (limited to AR, Pistol, SMG and SG).
biography: Jai's father was a military man and had died in one of the wars his country was involved in. Jai wanted to follow in his footsteps but at the same time forge his own path. His dad told him that he joined the army to bring justice to those who had harmed innocents. From a young age, this was a part of his psyche.

name: Oscar
quote: Don’t blink, the show’s about to begin!
ability_description: Dashes towards the target direction, detonating the first 3 Gloo Walls in the way with 25 DMG, while also dealing 25 DMG to and knocking back enemies encountered. Cooldown: 60s.
biography: A brilliant, even slightly overachieving student by day and a beloved vigilante by night. With his flashy physical prowess, Oscar leaps through the shadows to take down the evil.

name: Rin
quote: A true Yagami never falters
ability_description: Summons a kunai nearby every 8s, up to 3 kunai in total. The kunai can deal significant damage to Gloo Walls and will auto-target at any enemy or Gloo Wall that the user hits, dealing up to 12 DMG. The damage increase with distance.
biography: Hayato's younger sister, a skilled and calm ninja. As the second child of the Yagami family, she dwells in the shadow to keep her family's flame alive.

name: Nero
quote: Dreams are the true mirror of the unconscious.
ability_description: Throws a 1-HP plushie. The plushie lasts for 12s, ignores obstacles and can fly up to 50m (100m in BR). The plushie will track the nearest enemy in sight within 8m range and explode to create an 8m-radius dreamy space. Inside the space, the user and their enemies cannot place Gloo Walls. Their enemies also lose 6 HP/s. The space disappears once the plushie is destroyed. The destroyer will be marked for 5s. Cooldown: 45s
biography: A miraculous survivor of a brutal freeze, who gained the power to shape dreams on his last legs. All-powerful in the dreamspace, he acts solitarily and stays untraceable in the waking world.

name: Morse
quote: There's nothing I can't access.
ability_description: Enters the Stealth mode, during which the user is hard to be seen by enemies beyond 12m and cannot be detected by enemies. Meanwhile, gains a 20% speed boost and 25 temporary Shield Points. Lasts up to 13s. While stealthed, the user cannot fire. Exiting Stealth has a 0.5s delay. Aim assist will be triggered if there are enemies within 12m. Cooldown: 45s.
biography: Silent and free like a mouse, Morse never leaves a trace behind. He slips between the real world and the web, driven only by self-interests.

name: Ray
quote: Hati said the moon and the sun aren't rivals, I still believe in that.
ability_description: Releases the sunpower forward in a 30m fan-shaped range to tag the first undowned enemy hit for 10s and creates a link with them (visible in 40m to only the skill user and their tagged enemy). If the user reduces the tagged enemy's HP to 30 or below, the enemy is knocked down instantly. If the enemy is knocked down or eliminated while tagged, moonpower will reset the skill and restore the user's HP by 10/s for 3s in total. Cooldown: 45s.
biography: Tired of endless fighting, Ray chose to leave the gang behind with help from Shirou's father. Since then, he has wandered through the hidden corners of different cities, protecting the weak with his own power.
